title: Insert a new line with Enter key instead of sending a message
body:
I'd like to have an option to insert a new line with Enter key instead of sending a message. In CJK languages enter key is used to confirm the input and the current key binding very often leads to an incomplete message mistakenly sent to claude, which is annoying.

Currently we can only add new line with shift+enter by /terminal-setup command, but it does not support enter to add new line.
author: tmokmss

top_comments.author: ntc2
top_comments.body: Just realized I created a duplicate of your issue here: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/2335.

top_comments.author: convcha
top_comments.body:
I really want this option!
It’s super inconvenient for speakers of languages like Japanese, where we use Enter a lot when writing, to have it submit with Enter.

top_comments.author: jabr
top_comments.body:
I would love to have this, too. Sooooo many half written prompts sent accidentally... 

I just want a config option to invert the `return`/`modifier+return` behavior, like Zed's `use_modifier_to_send`:

> Make a modifier (cmd on macOS, ctrl on Linux) required to send messages. This is encouraged for more thoughtful prompt crafting. The default value is false.

https://zed.dev/docs/ai/agent-settings#modifier-to-send
